issues/20.title: Issue-Driven Autonomous Governance migration
issues/20.body:
## WHAT
Migrate Human-Gated LIGHT Governance v2 to Issue-Driven Autonomous Governance. Accountable Builder: Codex.
## WHY
Human defines WHAT/WHY/DONE once in an Issue; agents handle engineering, tests, Self-Review, PR, Ready, merge, Pages, evidence and closure without repeated Human approval.
## DONE
Read-only audit; separately committed migration Plan; updated governance and fully paired Traditional Chinese/English AGENTS; minimal native GitHub automation; tests, honest E2E/deployment evidence, Result and rollback procedure. Enable only when permissions, protection, retries and rollback are verified. Record unavailable runner/settings as blockers, never claim mock tests as live E2E.
## Boundary
Preserve Issue #18 / PR #19 and all their historical records unchanged. Use a separate PR from main. Preserve ChatGPT + Human ownership of V2/V3 content and approval; engineering imports approved content only. No direct main push, force push, bypass, secret disclosure, privilege expansion or governance platform. No unrelated repository changes.
## Authorization source
User's full migration instruction in Codex chat (2026-11-06 Asia/Taipei) explicitly authorizes audit → Plan → implementation → verification → Result and autonomous Ready/merge/deploy/closure within existing permissions. Plan is a record, not another approval gate. This text is Builder-recorded instruction, not independent identity verification.
## Completion
Do not close until required verification and evidence archival succeed. References #18 and #19 are historical context, not closure targets.

issues/18.title: [Governance] Learning Issue Forms + Tool-Neutral Single-Builder (Claude Code / Codex)
issues/18.body:
## WHAT
改造 GitHub Issue Template，建立 **Learning Record** 與 **Engineering Task** 兩種入口；同步將現行「Claude Code Single-Builder」修正為 **Tool-Neutral Single-Builder**：每個工程 Issue／PR 由一位明確指定的 accountable Builder 負責，可為 Claude Code 或 Codex。

## WHY
目前唯一表單 `01-agent-task.yml`、`GOVERNANCE.md`、`AGENTS.md` 均將 Claude Code 指定為 Builder，與實際可能由 Codex 執行工程工作不一致；而學習與教材創作在 ChatGPT 完成，應與工程任務分離。GitHub Issue 要留下可追溯的學習時間線，不應把教材作者錯指定給工程 Agent。

## Agreed Operating Model
1. **ChatGPT + Human：** V2 Knowledge Consolidation、V3 Code-First Deep Dive、內容品質驗收與整合定稿。
2. **V2/V3：** 製作時分開、定稿時合併、網站上依主題呈現。
3. **GitHub：** Issue 記錄學習歷程，Repository 保存已定稿教材，PR 記錄歸檔／工程變更。
4. **MkDocs：** 閱讀、搜尋、導覽、程式碼複製、公式、Mermaid、摺疊解說；暫不開發模擬器／後端。
5. **Engineering Builder：** Claude Code 或 Codex；單一 Issue／PR 在任一時點有一位明確負責的 Builder。工具中立不代表同時多位 Builder、免審查或授權轉移。

## Scope
- 新增 `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/02-learning-record.yml`：學科／課程／單元、學習目標、來源、V2／V3 里程碑、品質與證據、整合定稿、PR／歸檔連結。Issue 開立時不要求填寫尚未產生的成果；可透過 Issue Comments 逐步更新。
- 保留並重新命名／說明 `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/01-agent-task.yml` 為 **Engineering Task**，維持 WHAT／WHY／Acceptance／Boundary／References 既有基本欄位；不預設 Claude Code。
- **同步修正 `README.md`**：明確描述 ChatGPT＋Human 教材創作、Tool-Neutral Builder 工程職責、GitHub 學習歸檔與 MkDocs 閱讀定位；修正與現行手動部署及治理不一致的現行敘述。
- **同步修正 `AGENTS.md` 與 `GOVERNANCE.md`**：Tool-Neutral Single-Builder、內容所有權、交接／驗證及授權規則一致。
- 更新 `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml` 註解、`docs/development/ISSUE_TEMPLATE_INSTALL.md` 與必要的其他現行說明文件。對非 archived、非歷史證據的文件進行唯讀一致性搜尋，列出命中位置、處理決定與理由；只修改與本 Issue 直接相關的矛盾敘述。
- 對 `GOVERNANCE.md`、`AGENTS.md` 作最小必要調整：**Tool-Neutral Single-Builder + Self-Verification**，允許 Claude Code 或 Codex 作為本次指定 Builder；明確記錄 Builder、範圍、Commit SHA、Self-Review 與 Evidence。
- 檢查 PR Template 是否需加入 Builder 身分／交接欄位；若需更動，僅做最小修改。
- Builder 中途交接時，Issue／PR 必須記錄前後 Builder、交接點 SHA、已完成／未完成工作、驗證與阻擋；接手 Builder 對目前 head 與適用 base／scope 重新確認 Self-Review，不得沿用舊審查或默認移轉 Human 授權。
- 維持 L0–L3、formal Plan／Result、Draft PR、CI、Review、Human Approval、Merge 與部署權限的現有區分；不新增複雜平台。

## Boundary
- **Claude Code／Codex 不負責 V2／V3 教材創作、內容推導或語意修改。** 僅能忠實匯入已核准教材並處理排版、網站導覽、CI、PR 與發布工程；需要改變教材語意時回報 PENDING，由 ChatGPT／Human 決定。
- Learning Issue 的建立、PR Merge、Issue Closed 分別不代表已完成學習、已完成內容品質驗收或完全掌握知識。歸檔完成與學習完成明確區分。
- 不直接 push main；不啟用 Auto-Merge／自動部署；不修改 Merge and Close workflow 的邏輯；不變更 archived platform。
- 本案涉及治理角色，先視為 **L3 候選**。必須先提交 formal Plan、取得 Human 對 Plan 與具體實作範圍的明確授權，之後再實作；Merge 與 Deployment 另行授權。
- Issue 本身不構成實作、Merge、Close 或 Deploy 授權。

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] GitHub New Issue 可選 Learning Record 與 Engineering Task 兩種表單（合併前僅能檢查 schema；合併後實際 UI readback）
- [ ] Learning 表單清楚標示 ChatGPT＋Human 為教材作者，V2/V3 可分階段追蹤，未完成欄位不強制預填
- [ ] Engineering 表單保留既有基本欄位，不再限定 Claude Code
- [ ] README.md、AGENTS.md、GOVERNANCE.md、Issue Forms、PR Template 與現行操作文件的角色、內容所有權及部署描述一致
- [ ] 完成現行文件一致性稽核清單（檔案／矛盾敘述／處理方式／證據）；歷史 Records、已合併 PR 與 archived 文件維持原貌
- [ ] Claude Code 與 Codex 任一均可被明確指定為單一 Builder，遵循相同的 Self-Review、Evidence、風險及授權要求
- [ ] Builder 交接有 SHA、範圍、待辦、證據及重新確認審查機制，不假裝舊驗證有效
- [ ] GitHub Issue Form YAML／schema、適用測試與 CI 通過，現有 Merge Workflow 行為未改變
- [ ] 正式 Plan 先於實作獨立 commit；L3 Human 核准先於實作；完成後保留 Result／Self-Review／Evidence
- [ ] 沒有未授權 Merge、Close、Deploy 或直接修改 main
- [ ] 未實際驗證項目如實標示 NOT RUN／PENDING

## Builder Execution Boundary — Phase 1 Only
先做唯讀 Investigation、Risk Assessment、Formal Plan（先於實作 commit）與 Draft PR 準備。回報 Plan 版本、Commit SHA、Draft PR URL、需要 Human 核准的具體實作範圍後 **STOP**。不得先行修改實作檔案、Merge、Close Issue 或 Deploy。

**This Issue is a request and planning record, NOT implementation / merge / deployment authorization.**

## Additional Human Request — AGENTS.md bilingual edition (2026-11-06)
- 將 `AGENTS.md` 改為**繁體中文＋英文雙語版本**，每條政策完整對應；不是僅把既有中英混用敘述保留原狀。
- 保留相同治理語義、L0–L3、工具中立 Single-Builder、ChatGPT／Human 教材所有權、交接、Plan/Result、Self-Review、Ready/Merge/Deployment 的獨立授權，不增刪規則、不修改其他正式檔案。
- 建議以一條繁體中文與對應英文逐段並列，避免兩套規則各自漂移；全文保留單一 `AGENTS.md`。
- 這是 READY_ELIGIBLE 判定後的新增變更：先重新評估已核准 Plan／L3 授權的覆蓋範圍；如需修訂 Plan，提交新版本並取得 Human 核准後再實作。不得以本 Issue 補充條款自行推定已獲新實作授權。
- 完成後更新必要的 `records/ISSUE-18/` Evidence／Result、PR Self-Review，重新核對新 Head、適用 CI、MkDocs strict 與文件語義一致性；先前固定 Head `d0f400cc56a4aa3db914c0029cd6e9c1f9292038` 的 READY_ELIGIBLE 不自動適用新 Head。
- 在新增要求完成並重新通過 Gate 前，PR #19 **維持 Draft**；不得 Merge、Close Issue 或 Deploy。

pulls/19.title: [L3][Draft] Issue #18 學習表單與工具中立單一 Builder
pulls/19.body:
## 最新狀態：Plan v1.2 雙語化完成，等待 Human 審查

Issue：#18；唯一 accountable Builder：Codex；風險：L3；PR 維持 Draft。

**完整 Head／本次 Self-Review SHA：`7efb0521d63b646501b83ecafdfb40da473d914b`**
base：`7e530cdc818044ae4f760a021a331f888f993e43`，main 未變。

Human 在本聊天「Issue #18 — Formal Plan v1.2 Approval & Bilingual Implementation Authorization」分別核准 Plan `f0353b0ee784f60319ae54b89086321c7d20e634` 與三檔實作。[Timeline 版本／SHA／授權參考](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/issues/18#issuecomment-6686502162) 已發布並讀回；此為 Builder 紀錄，不冒充原生 Human Review 或自動身分驗證。

### 變更與順序

- [核准 Plan v1.2](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/f0353b0ee784f60319ae54b89086321c7d20e634/records/ISSUE-18/PLAN.md) 原文未改；其當時 PENDING 為規劃歷史，本段記錄後續 Human 授權。
- 實作 commit：`88e109756faa84ed852e8f135fb33319e29a5e58`，僅 [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/7efb0521d63b646501b83ecafdfb40da473d914b/AGENTS.md)。
- Result／Evidence commit：`7efb0521d63b646501b83ecafdfb40da473d914b`，新增 [17 列完整語義矩陣](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/7efb0521d63b646501b83ecafdfb40da473d914b/records/ISSUE-18/BILINGUAL-EVIDENCE.md)，僅追加 [Result 補充](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/7efb0521d63b646501b83ecafdfb40da473d914b/records/ISSUE-18/RESULT.md)。
- 相對核准 Plan 僅上述三檔，其他正式文件／Workflows／Scripts／歷史 Records／Archived Platform 未變。Plan bytes 相同，舊 Result bytes 完整為新 Result 前綴；未修改 Settings。
- Git 親子順序確認：核准 Plan → AGENTS 實作 → Evidence／Result。未偽造歷史。

### 最新 Head 驗證

| 檢查 | 結果 |
|---|---|
| 17 條結構、順序、每條雙語獨立完整 | PASS |
| 原文→繁中、原文→英文、繁中↔英文語義自審 | 17/17 PASS；12 條原英文逐字保留（路徑 Markdown 標記除外） |
| Mandatory／Optional／Prohibited、條件與例外、授權與證據 | PASS；詳見逐條矩陣及關鍵情境 |
| GOVERNANCE／README／INSTALL／表單／PR Template／安裝說明一致性 | PASS，未發現翻譯引入的衝突 |
| unittest discovery | PASS，27 tests |
| MkDocs strict build | PASS；根目錄 AGENTS 另做 Markdown HTML 17 組檢查 |
| git diff --check | PASS |
| verify_plan_records + 額外本次三 commit 順序與白名單 | PASS；verifier 僅證明結構與 Git 順序，不證明語義核准 |
| [Governance Tests](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/actions/runs/42230400714) | PASS，綁定本段完整 Head |
| [Docs Check](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/actions/runs/42230400715) | PASS，綁定本段完整 Head |
| Remote Readback | PASS；fetch 分支 Head 相同，GitHub Contents API 讀回 AGENTS／Plan／Evidence／Result bytes 均相同；Draft true、Issue open、未 merged |
| 原生 Reviews／Review Threads | 查詢均空；無已知阻擋項 |

Result／Evidence 在 records 提交時記為 PENDING 的最終 CI、Git 順序與 readback，已由本段綁定完整 Head 補齊 PASS。未為更新證據而修改已核准 Plan 或覆寫歷史 Result。

### Self-Review 結論與限制

Claim：原 17 條治理語義、順序、強制／可選／禁止及授權邊界保留。Source：固定原 AGENTS、核准 Plan、現行治理及 Human 明確授權。Method：三向逐條語義閱讀、完整矩陣、關鍵情境、文件一致性、範圍／bytes／Git 順序、適用測試與最新 Head CI／遠端 readback。Codex 已重新審查最終 records Head，base／scope／risk 無擴張，無已知未解語義歧義或實作 blocker。

這是 Builder Self-Review，**不是獨立 Review、原生 APPROVED 或 Human 最終驗收**。Fresh-Context Challenge 本次省略：17 列三向核對、12 條英文保留及限定差異提供可追溯證據，未發現翻譯歧義；Human 未指定 challenge。維持 L3，仍需 Human 審閱自然語言翻譯。

- GitHub Issue Forms 合併後 UI：PENDING，留待後續授權合併後核對。
- Browser／GitHub Markdown 視覺：NOT RUN；HTML 結構不冒充瀏覽器驗收。
- 額外 lifecycle／Archived helper runner：NOT RUN，適用性理由見 Evidence；未宣稱此次重跑。
- 教材：無創作或匯入；CI 不等於品質核准或學習掌握。
- Deployment：NOT RUN，未授權。

**未沿用舊 READY_ELIGIBLE。保持 Draft；Ready／Merge／Close Issue／Deploy／workflow_dispatch 均未授權且未執行。完成後 STOP，等待 Human 下一次審查。**

---
## 以下為既有 Phase 2 固定 Head 的歷史證據
以下「最終 Head」均指 `d0f400cc56a4aa3db914c0029cd6e9c1f9292038`，不表示 v1.2 新增雙語工作已完成。

## 目的與結果
Issue: #18

完成 Learning Record／Engineering Task 兩種入口及 Tool-Neutral Single-Builder + Self-Verification 文件一致性修正。Learning Record 僅三項初始資訊必填，五項成果欄位可後續留言更新；學習 Issue 不強制對應工程 PR，只有 Repository 變更需要工程流程。

ChatGPT＋Human 擁有教材創作、推導、品質核准及整合定稿權；V2／V3 製作時分開、定稿時合併、網站上依主題呈現。工程 Builder 僅忠實匯入已核准內容及處理工程。Claude Code／Codex 適用相同規範，每個工程 Issue／PR 任一時點只有一位 accountable Builder；交接記錄完整 SHA、base／scope／risk、進度、Evidence／Blockers，接手者重新審查並確認適用授權，不自動繼承。

## 範圍與風險
本次 accountable Builder：**Codex**；維持 **L3**。
僅修改 Human 授權的九個實作檔案及 `records/ISSUE-18/` 證據。README／INSTALL 的舊角色、工程步驟及自動部署描述已修正。Workflows、Scripts、歷史 Records、Archived Platform、教材與其餘基準檔案逐檔位元組相同。Merge workflow blob 仍為 `9b014e67583818e03442f136b3aedf80f05620fc`；既有 Merge／Auto-Merge／Deployment 授權規範保留。必要回復須另行授權 revert PR，不重寫歷史。

## 授權與 Commit
- 審查 base：`7e530cdc818044ae4f760a021a331f888f993e43`（main 未變）。
- Human 核准 Plan v1.1：`70acc21a5d15a9061c8b2a896b5b9a9987cda7cd`，版本歷史與原文保留。
- [Human Phase 2 授權來源紀錄](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/d0f400cc56a4aa3db914c0029cd6e9c1f9292038/records/ISSUE-18/AUTHORIZATION.md)：本聊天明確批准固定 Plan 並授權 Codex 實作／驗證；Builder 紀錄不是獨立身分認證。
- [Approved Plan Timeline](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/issues/18#issuecomment-6685131674)：已發佈並回讀版本／SHA／Records／範圍／授權邊界。
- 實作前授權紀錄 commit：`334f61da22c8e777bcc562ad5b9171067ce805af`。
- 九檔實作 commit：`d32c5b57d4f5313a247fa34db547d08463c078a5`。
- **最終 Head／本次重新確認的 Self-Review SHA：`d0f400cc56a4aa3db914c0029cd6e9c1f9292038`**。

## 驗證與 Evidence
| 檢查 | 結果 |
|---|---|
| unittest discovery | PASS，27 tests |
| Merge lifecycle | PASS，3 組，runner 回報 6+7+3 情境 |
| 歸檔 helper／API 參數模擬 | PASS，6 項 |
| YAML／官方 schema 使用子集 | PASS；名稱／ID／型別／必填／無預填成果 |
| 既有工程欄位契約 | PASS；五個 ID、型別、順序及必填設定相同 |
| 文件一致性與雙向交接桌上情境 | PASS；詳見 Verification 與逐行搜尋 |
| 未授權檔案與原授權規範保留 | PASS；逐檔位元組／授權段落比對 |
| 本地 MkDocs strict／HTML 結構 | PASS；8 欄位資料列；不是視覺或教材品質驗收 |
| git diff --check | PASS |
| Plan／Result Git 順序 | PASS；於最終 head 執行 verify_plan_records.py，僅證明結構／順序 |
| 最終 head Governance Tests | [PASS](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/actions/runs/42222028943) |
| 最終 head Docs Check／strict MkDocs | [PASS](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/actions/runs/42222029090) |
| 遠端 readback | PASS；已 fetch 遠端分支並比較完整樹相同，Plan 固定版本及最終 Result 可讀，main 未變 |

[Result](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/d0f400cc56a4aa3db914c0029cd6e9c1f9292038/records/ISSUE-18/RESULT.md) · [驗證原文／Self-Review Evidence](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/d0f400cc56a4aa3db914c0029cd6e9c1f9292038/records/ISSUE-18/VERIFICATION.md) · [實作後搜尋](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/d0f400cc56a4aa3db914c0029cd6e9c1f9292038/records/ISSUE-18/MATCHES-AFTER.txt) · [原 Documentation Consistency Matrix](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/d0f400cc56a4aa3db914c0029cd6e9c1f9292038/records/ISSUE-18/DOCUMENTATION-CONSISTENCY.md)

Result 寫入時標為 PENDING 的最終紀錄順序、CI、readback，已在此以完整最終 head 補齊 PASS。Result 之後無實作變更。

## Self-Review 結論
Codex 實際完成來源調查、九檔實作、差異審查、schema／契約檢查、逐項 Matrix 處置、雙向 handoff 情境、授權段落與未授權路徑比對、測試、Result 與遠端核對。最終 records commit 僅新增證據，已重新確認目前 head／base／scope／risk。

## On-Demand Architecture Revision — candidate verified, live lifecycle BLOCKED

Issue: #20. 唯一 accountable Builder：Codex。
Reviewed final head: `14511069cd03a8a406b36238d296a3df7ef74a4b`
Reviewed main/base: `7e530cdc818044ae4f760a021a331f888f993e43`。
**維持 Draft/open；本次未 Ready、Merge、Deploy 或 Close。**

Human 決定採按需工程：需要時啟動 Codex App，Builder 自主工程與符合 Gate 的生命週期；正常本機流程使用既有 App 登入及 gh auth，不需額外 OPENAI_API_KEY／CLH_AUTOMATION_TOKEN。GitHub-hosted Issue Agent／排程 lifecycle 已停用，保留 CI／main 保護。Pages 改為 Builder 指定 merge SHA 的原生 Actions dispatch；沒有常駐服務、新憑證或設定變更。

## Plan → implementation → Result

- [唯讀 Audit](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/14511069cd03a8a406b36238d296a3df7ef74a4b/records/ISSUE-20/ON-DEMAND-REVISION-AUDIT.md) / [正式 Revision Plan](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/14511069cd03a8a406b36238d296a3df7ef74a4b/records/ISSUE-20/ON-DEMAND-REVISION-PLAN.md)：獨立 commit `51b1c2927b85d7546e59e882f8f46f0e651c75d9`，先 push 並逐位元組讀回才實作。
- 實作：`90643309cc87978b7720cdb629f31ed95c7c7c0b`。
- Revision acceptance heading verifier 修正：`c37275eb05dd80574fd482b3a9a9fc7ee1db66ed`。
- [Result／完整變更檔案清單](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/14511069cd03a8a406b36238d296a3df7ef74a4b/records/ISSUE-20/ON-DEMAND-REVISION-RESULT.md)、[Self-Review](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/14511069cd03a8a406b36238d296a3df7ef74a4b/records/ISSUE-20/ON-DEMAND-REVISION-SELF-REVIEW.md)、[E2E 矩陣](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/14511069cd03a8a406b36238d296a3df7ef74a4b/records/ISSUE-20/ON-DEMAND-REVISION-E2E.md) 與證據 commit：本段 final head。
- 原始 Audit/Plan/Result/Self-Review/E2E、#18/#19 與 Git 歷史全部保留；41 份既有 records/archive 檔案 bytes 相同。#19 仍 Draft/open，head `7efb0521d63b646501b83ecafdfb40da473d914b`。

## Implementation

明確指定單一 PR 與完整 head/base 的本機 check/run；check 不寫 GitHub。共用 Git-dir OS lock；Ready 後重新驗證 PR/head/base/Issue/CI/reviews；精確 head merge API；部署 run 與遠端 SHA bytes 驗證；Archive readback → 再核對需求 → Close。中斷後使用遠端既有 merge SHA/archive 恢復，不重複 Merge。歷史 bundle library/tests 留存，hosted CLI 關閉。

18 個實作檔案涵蓋 workflows、lifecycle/verifier/tests、治理與操作文件；AGENTS 15 組完整繁中／英文保留，僅 01/14 成對加入 on-demand 語義。教材未變。

## Current-head verification

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Local unit/regression | **68 PASS**；[原始輸出](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/14511069cd03a8a406b36238d296a3df7ef74a4b/records/ISSUE-20/ON-DEMAND-REVISION-TESTS.txt)，保留原有 53 測試，新增 15；不是 live E2E |
| Strict MkDocs | PASS；[build](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/14511069cd03a8a406b36238d296a3df7ef74a4b/records/ISSUE-20/ON-DEMAND-REVISION-BUILD.txt) |
| Workflow lint / diff | PASS；actionlint 1.7.12 無 suppression；[lint](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/14511069cd03a8a406b36238d296a3df7ef74a4b/records/ISSUE-20/ON-DEMAND-REVISION-LINT.txt) |
| Revision + original Plan/Result order | PASS，兩次 verifier 在 final records commit 後執行；不代表語義核准 |
| GitHub Governance Tests | [PASS](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/actions/runs/42313343636)，final head |
| GitHub Docs Check | [PASS](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/actions/runs/42313343711)，final head |
| Live read-only | native protection preflight PASS；incomplete #21 check 正確 BLOCKED，無 mutation；[settings/evidence](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/blob/14511069cd03a8a406b36238d296a3df7ef74a4b/records/ISSUE-20/ON-DEMAND-REVISION-EVIDENCE.json) |
| Remote readback | PASS：9 份 revision records + AGENTS/lifecycle/Pages 共 12 檔 bytes 相同；fetch head/tree/base 相同 |
| Native reviews / threads | 空；本記錄不冒充 APPROVED 或獨立 Review |

額外 standalone legacy runners：4 個 exit 0；final_findings 的 2 個舊 Human 授權／workflow concurrency 斷言 **FAIL**，已確認在修訂前 baseline 亦失敗，並非新架構適用 Gate。保留結果，未改成假 PASS；替代行為由現行 lifecycle/lock/recovery 測試驗證。

## Self-Review and limitations

Claim：按需、無新增憑證依賴、保留 gates/history。Source：Issue、Human architecture comment、Plan、實際 GitHub settings。Method：完整差異與 source tracing、負向狀態測試、15 條雙語對照、remote bytes、目前 CI。Evidence：上列新 records。最終 records-only head 已重新閱讀／核對，base/scope 未變。Fresh-Context Challenge 省略：無 Human mandate；使用逐項 state-transition/source/readback 驗證，未委派其他 Agent。這是 Builder Self-Review，不是獨立審查或身分驗證。

Build PASS；教材／來源 unchanged（不代表教材核准）；visual NOT RUN；deployment NOT RUN。
完整 live Ready → Merge → Pages/SHA → Archive → Close **BLOCKED/NOT RUN**：本次架構指令明確禁止 Merge/Deploy/Close，且候選 workflow 尚未在 main。不是缺少 API key/token。未加入 complete=true lifecycle block。

Remaining risks：WSL/Linux lock 非跨機分散鎖；REST 無 atomic expected-base CAS，靠新鮮讀取與 strict native checks；Issue 留言／stop 仍由 Builder 讀取；main 前進會阻擋舊 SHA dispatch；真實 mutation 權限、live failure/recovery 與 revert deployment 尚未驗證。保留 Draft，必要後續 lifecycle 驗收完成前不宣稱整體上線。

原 hosted 實作的歷史說明與 BLOCKED 證據保留在原 records 及 [Issue #20 歷史留言](https://github.com/myaiwouldbemine/myaiwouldbemine-Copy-Learning-Hub/issues/20#issuecomment-6698138892)；本段只報告新版實際結果。

**Decision by Human:** CLH does **not** need unattended operation while the computer is off or the ChatGPT/Codex App is closed. Replace the always-on GitHub-hosted agent assumption with **On-Demand Autonomous Engineering**, preferably initiated through local Codex App. This is a scope/architecture change to Issue #20 / Draft PR #21, not permission to bypass gates.

**Builder (Codex) instructions:**
1. **Audit before editing.** Read the current PR #21 head `bb577319ba003f3b92ef4fc7cf0cd717e8315cac`, `GOVERNANCE.md`, bilingual `AGENTS.md`, workflows, scripts, `docs/development/AUTONOMOUS_OPERATIONS.md`, and all `records/ISSUE-20/` evidence. Confirm current remote head/base again before working.
2. **Produce a formal revision Plan first**, under a new non-overwriting record such as `records/ISSUE-20/ON-DEMAND-REVISION-PLAN.md`. Include WHAT/WHY/DONE, alternatives (local Codex App vs manual trigger vs hosted), execution boundary and credentials, exact file-level change map, lifecycle design, threat/race analysis, CI and deployment gates, rollback, test matrix, and preservation of the existing 53-test baseline and historical evidence. Identify which tests remain relevant and which require replacement. Explicitly analyze whether GitHub-hosted merge/deploy can use native tokens or must be invoked locally; do not assume this without proof.
3. **Commit the Plan separately before implementation**, preserving the commit history, original Audit/Plan/Result/Self-Review/E2E and #18/#19 history. No force push, rebase rewriting, deletion, or misleading reinterpretation of historical BLOCKED/PASS evidence.
4. **Then implement according to the recorded Plan** with the same accountable Builder. Human creates Issues and starts Codex when available; Codex handles Plan → Code → Tests → Self-Review → PR. Preserve GitHub CI, strict main protection, exact-SHA gates, deployment/readback where applicable, archive-before-close, idempotency, and fail-closed behavior. Do not require `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `CLH_AUTOMATION_TOKEN` for the chosen normal local workflow. Remove or disable unattended hosted Issue Agent / periodic autonomous model execution; minimize complexity without discarding valuable governance.
5. **Validate** with new local and real GitHub E2E evidence, including negative cases (failed CI, stale SHA, permission failure, duplicate triggers, deployment failure, archive failure). Distinguish unit tests, actual CI, and live E2E. Update bilingual docs, operational guide, PR body and new revision Result/Self-Review; maintain old records unmodified. Capture links and commit SHAs.
6. **Keep PR #21 Draft** until the revised acceptance criteria and evidence are met. Do not merge, deploy, close Issue #20, set `CLH_AUTONOMY_ENABLED=true`, install credentials, or weaken rulesets as part of this request. Surface genuine blockers with evidence; do not request repetitive Human approval for routine engineering steps.

**Acceptance:** The new design works on demand when the user's computer/Codex session is active, has no requirement for unattended off-device AI operation, preserves Git history/evidence and safeguards, and demonstrates the complete applicable lifecycle without invented success claims.

Please begin with the **revision Plan**, commit it independently, then proceed with implementation and tests. This GitHub comment is a handoff request; posting it alone does not start a Codex execution.
